title: issue #17: root-commit blindness + the merge union over-report — one per-commit file law

events.command:
S=/home/excelsior/Desktop/stallion/tools; A=$(mktemp -d); cd "$A"; git init -q -b master; git config user.email p@p; git config user.name p; echo base > base.txt; git add -A; git commit -qm "orphan root with code, no footer"; git checkout -q --orphan evil; mkdir -p apps; echo smuggle > apps/smuggled.mjs; git add apps; git commit -qm "evil orphan: code, no footer"; cp -r "$S" tools; node tools/task-coverage.mjs --base master >/dev/null 2>&1 && { echo "ROOT SMUGGLE PASSED THE FENCE"; exit 1; }; echo "root smuggle refused"; Y=$(mktemp -d); cd "$Y"; git init -q -b master; git config user.email p@p; git config user.name p; echo base > base.txt; git add -A; git commit -qm base; cp -r "$S" tools; git add tools; git commit -qm "vendor the harness"; node tools/task-state.mjs new fence-probe --risk-class runtime-code >/dev/null; node tools/task-state.mjs advance fence-probe planned >/dev/null; node tools/task-state.mjs scope fence-probe --add "apps/**" >/dev/null; node tools/task-state.mjs advance fence-probe executing >/dev/null; git checkout -qb feat; mkdir apps; echo ok > apps/ok.mjs; git add -A; git commit -qm "feat: ok

task: fence-probe"; git checkout -q master; git merge -q --no-ff --no-commit feat >/dev/null 2>&1; echo extra > apps/extra.mjs; git add -A; git commit -qm "merge with content beyond both parents"; BASE=$(git rev-parse HEAD~2); node tools/task-coverage.mjs --base "$BASE" >/dev/null 2>&1 && { echo "EVIL MERGE PASSED THE FENCE"; exit 1; }; echo "evil merge refused"; exit 0
